title: MPESB MP ASI, Subedar Steno Recruitment 2026 Apply Online for 655 Post
postName: MP Subedar Steno and ASI Ministerial Recruitment Test 2026
vacancyDetails: 655 posts: Subedar Steno General Branch, Subedar Steno Special Branch, ASI Ministerial General Branch (100), ASI Ministerial Field Unit (370), ASI Ministerial Special Branch (25), and ASI Ministerial Crime Investigation Department (25).
qualification: Intermediate passed from a recognized board. Subedar Steno candidates must have Hindi shorthand speed of 100 words per minute and CPCT with Hindi typing. ASI Ministerial candidates must have CPCT with Hindi typing.
ageLimit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 33 years for male candidates and 38 years for female candidates as on 08/10/2026. Relaxation as per MPESB rules.
applicationFee: General / Other State: 560/-. EWS / OBC / SC / ST: 310/-. Portal charges: 60/- included. Pay through MPOnline kiosk, debit card, credit card, net banking or UPI.
selectionProcess: Written examination followed by post-wise shorthand, typing, CPCT, document verification and other stages prescribed by MPESB.
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, identity proof, photograph, signature, category certificate and other documents specified in the notification.
howToApply:
1. Read the MPESB notification and rulebook carefully.
2. Visit the MPESB online application portal.
3. Apply online between 24/09/2026 and 08/10/2026.
4. Upload the required documents and pay the applicable fee.
5. Check the preview, submit the form and keep the confirmation page.
shortDescription: MPESB MP ASI and Subedar Steno Ministerial Recruitment 2026 for 655 posts. Apply online from 24 September 2026 to 08 October 2026.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the MP ASI, Subedar Steno Recruitment 2026 notification for 655 posts.

Interested candidates can apply online from 24/09/2026 to 08/10/2026. Read the official notification and rulebook before applying.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 24/09/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 08/10/2026
  • Last Date Pay Exam Fee: 08/10/2026
  • Correction Last Date: 13/10/2026
  • Exam Start Date: 03/11/2026
  • Admit Card: Before Exam
  • Answer Key: After Exam
  • Result: Notified Soon

Physical Eligibility

  • Male Height: 167.5 CMS
  • Female Height: 152.4 CMS
